skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and principles of microeconomics, analyze simple economic models, and apply theories to practical problems.
Analyze consumer and producer behavior, understand market structures, and evaluate government policies.
Develop independent thinking and the ability to solve economic problems through logical reasoning.
Apply economic theories to solve practical economic problems and evaluate policy impacts.
Conduct research, analyze, synthesize, and generalize economic issues.
Work independently and in groups to solve economic problems.
Develop self-study habits and accumulate experience to enhance professional skills.
Maintain discipline, be proactive, and take responsibility for assigned tasks.
Communicate effectively in seminars and discussions.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and participate in class activities.
